title: Delhi's air in winter 2026: every stage, every spike
dek: From a clean October day to Diwali smog and Stage III curbs. How Delhi's air turned this season, and what the rules mean for you.
seoTitle: Delhi AQI and GRAP 2026: winter pollution timeline
bigLabel: Delhi's AQI at 7 am on 9 Nov, the season's highest so far, with several stations above 400

glance.what: Delhi's air went from an AQI of 60 in late October to 'very poor' in November. Pollution curbs moved from Stage I on 21 October to Stage III on 6 November, and Diwali brought the worst festival-day air since 2021.
glance.why: Air in the 'very poor' and 'severe' bands harms everyone's lungs, especially children, older people and anyone with asthma or heart disease. Each GRAP stage adds limits on construction, vehicles and burning.
glance.next: Stage III stays until the air commission says otherwise. Out-of-state vehicles that are not BS-VI are barred from Delhi until 31 January 2027.

forYou: Check the AQI before going out, limit outdoor exercise on 'very poor' and 'severe' days, and follow the official CAQM orders for what Stage III restricts. If your car is registered outside Delhi and is not BS-VI, it can be turned back at the border until 31 January.

events.title: Stage I curbs as air turns 'poor'
events.summary: The air quality commission puts Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) in force across Delhi-NCR, with Delhi's AQI at 244.

events.title: A clean day after rain: AQI 60
events.summary: Rain brings Delhi's AQI down to 60, its cleanest October day in four years. It climbs to 117 on 31 October and 261 on 1 November.

events.title: Winter plan: older outside vehicles barred
events.summary: Delhi's winter action plan starts. Vehicles registered outside Delhi that do not meet BS-VI standards are barred from entering until 31 January 2027, with exemptions. The Delhi High Court refuses to stay the rule.

events.title: Stage II as AQI crosses 300
events.summary: Delhi's air enters the 'very poor' band for the first time this season. With AQI at 324 by 4 pm, the commission brings in Stage II across the whole NCR.

events.title: Worst air in 288 days
events.summary: Delhi's 24-hour average AQI reaches 377, its worst in 288 days, with at least 10 stations above 400.

events.title: Stage III invoked before Diwali
events.summary: With Delhi's daily average AQI at 382 and stations such as IIT Delhi and Rohini at 474, the commission invokes Stage III across Delhi-NCR with immediate effect.

events.title: Diwali: worst festival air since 2021
events.summary: Delhi records an average AQI of 376 at 4 pm on Diwali, its highest festival-day reading since 2021.

events.title: Season high of 391; protesters detained
events.summary: AQI hits 391 at 7 am, the season's highest so far, with Bawana at 436. Police detain people protesting at India Gate for action on pollution. AAP leader Saurabh Bharadwaj alleges water is being sprayed on monitoring stations; that claim is his and has not been verified.

events.title: Slight relief, still 'very poor'
events.summary: AQI eases to 345 at 8 am. Stage III stays in force.
